Why locals love LIFT

Warm, vintage, and made by hand

LIFT is an owner-led cafe with an old-soul feel — mismatched charm, honest food, and the sort of welcome that turns a coffee run into the best part of the day.

🍵

Homemade chai, properly spiced

The chai is the signature — brewed in-house with real spices, never from a syrup bottle. It's the cup regulars cross the suburb for.

🎂

Baked here, celebrated everywhere

From counter cakes to full special-occasion centrepieces, everything is baked with care. Tell us the occasion and we'll dream up the cake.

🐾

Bring the laptop, bring the dog

Settle in with your laptop for a slow work morning, or bring your four-legged co-worker — dogs are part of the family at LIFT.

Special occasions

A cake for your big day

Birthdays, weddings, baby showers, "just because" — LIFT bakes cakes for special occasions to order. Send an enquiry and the cafe will come back with flavours, sizing and a quote. The quickest way to reach them is an Instagram DM to @liftbne.

This demo form doesn't send anything on its own — it writes your enquiry out so you can send it by Instagram DM or read it over the phone.
